purpose: S3 recorded source-only conditional residual diagnosis, not causality or model selection

definitions.r_fp32: Separate FP64 logs cast FP32 then promoted before subtraction
definitions.label_strata: Posthoc true-cardinality groups are not deployable input conditions
definitions.support: Unique and sampled-unique >=200 per condition; absent cells and sparse denominators retained
definitions.conditions: PG bucket and counts only, not complete features or SQL equivalence
definitions.standardization: Validation condition mass, independent of residual values; no learned calibration
